W1.prediction: reselection can make additive claims disagree with full waveform effects
W1.falsifier: mean absolute reselection term below 0.05 on correlated/competition fixtures

W2.estimand: joint removal of every predeclared diagnostic component versus mean individual removal
W2.prediction: redundant groups can matter more than any single member
W2.falsifier: mean absolute joint effect minus individual effect <= 0.25 on redundant/correlated fixtures
W2.limitation: groups are generator-declared; no real-data grouping is validated

W3.estimand: Jaccard distance of selected identities under 0.01-uV noise/ranking jitter on eight tied copies
W3.prediction: 0.5-uV rounded ranking lowers mean instability by >=0.05 at K=4
W3.falsifier: instability reduction <0.05 or clean dual accuracy drops >0.02
W3.capacity: identical 75 parameters, K=4, training examples/updates; no learned attention

W4.estimand: spread of full true-stage effects across bridge/background/noise erasers
W4.negative_control: phase-scramble donor retains spectral information and is not an eraser
diagnostics: elementary guard acceptance is not physiological validity

confirmatory: locked config and matrix committed before new Phase II experiments
exploratory: any later generator, thresholds, selectors or analyses must be separately labeled; never replace confirmatory outputs
generator_correction: Complementary one-factor cases uniformly retain A or B, independent of label; original v1 always retained A.
